kde-style.label: KDE + GTK colours, fonts, cursor and decorations
kde-style.note: Qogir cursors and Utterly Round decoration assets are bundled.

kde-shortcuts.label: All KDE shortcuts + keyboard layouts + screenshot helpers

fish.label: Fish aliases, greeting and notification settings
fish.note: The fiw-update alias is enabled only when that local helper exists. Font icons use the optional fonts preset.

kitty.label: Kitty lavender profiles
kitty.note: Select fonts separately for the bundled JetBrainsMono Nerd Font.

neovim.label: Neovim transparent purple style
neovim.note: Catppuccin is optional; the captured purple highlights also work with the built-in fallback.

fastfetch.label: Fastfetch tree layout with Gentoo logo

autostart.label: Optional application autostart
autostart.note: Only apps from selected package groups with an installed launch command are started.

ark.label: Ark sidebar, status bar and extraction behaviour

gwenview.label: Gwenview menu bar and information sidebar

prism.label: Prism appearance, console and launcher behaviour
prism.note: Native Gentoo path. Minecraft instances, accounts, Java locations and memory limits remain local.
